decisions.reason: Both semantic top-1 and LLM choice use the same US Hospitals API, which is not suitable for finding car rental locations.
LLM choice (Tripadvisor - Search Rental Cars Location) directly matches the task of querying car rental locations, unlike the semantic top-1.
Neither semantic top-1 nor LLM choice provide an API for live traffic conditions; LLM choice is unrelated to traffic.
